dedupe_keys.name: subnational human development index shdi and gender development index global data lab

description: The Subnational Human Development Index translates UNDP's Human Development Index to regions within countries, averaging subnational values for education, health and standard of living, and a companion Subnational Gender Development Index does the same for UNDP's GDI. The Global Data Lab at Radboud University produces both, described by Jeroen Smits and Iñaki Permanyer in a 2019 Scientific Data descriptor, and offers maps and data tables by country, time and indicator. Coverage is global at the subnational level for all countries with data. Format and access: web maps and tables, with Excel and CSV downloads of full datasets or sub-samples after free registration. Licence: GDL terms, citing both the database and the paper; free. Caveats: regional values are partly modelled from household surveys and scaled to national UNDP figures, so small regions carry more uncertainty, and the years covered were not listed on the page read. For hazard exposure and resilience studies it gives a development and equity layer for weighting infrastructure service loss and exposure by region. Related catalogue records are the GDL Vulnerability Index and the CDC Social Vulnerability Index.
